explicit_remainder.ledger/money.py:
from decimal import Decimal


def charge(amount: str) -> str:
    value = Decimal(amount)
    scaled = value * 100
    whole = int(scaled)
    remainder = abs(scaled - whole)
    if remainder >= Decimal("0.5"):
        whole += 1 if value >= 0 else -1
    result = Decimal(whole) / 100
    return f"{result:.2f}"

requirements.A: ordinary amounts round to two decimal places and keep two decimals in the output
requirements.B: an exact midpoint rounds away from zero, for positive and negative amounts
